control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the right light is above 75 %, it drives forward at 30 %; else it calls stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, it stops; else it calls followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, it curves left (10 %, 40 %); else it curves right (40 %, 10 %).

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads more than 75 %

branches.outcome: dim (75 % or less): it checks the wall and the line
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it follows the line
